adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a singleton-like `embedding` model backed by `Admin::EmbeddingController#show`/`#update`, where `#update` simply re-renders the same `OpenStruct` (no persistence/side effects) and a PUT route is exposed (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`). On the client, `admin-embedding` controller defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `embedding.hbs` contains no UI element that triggers `saveChanges`, so the write path is effectively dead code. This is a valid architecture/scope concern (fake model id `default`, stand-in resource used to sideload `embeddable_hosts`). However, the finding’s claim that `store.findAll('embeddable-host')` can replace this “with no behavior loss” is not verifiable from the diff because `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` does not implement an `index` action, so a `findAll` would not currently work without additional changes.
